pages.quiz:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "Es geht" mean as an answer to "Wie geht's?" (1 mark)
   A. It is very good
   B. It is goodbye
   C. It is so-so
   D. It is very bad

2. What does "Bitte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good night
   B. see you tomorrow
   C. bye (friendly)
   D. please

3. Which noun goes with "meine"? (1 mark)
   A. Vater
   B. Onkel
   C. Mutter
   D. Bruder

4. What does "der Sohn" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. uncle
   B. son
   C. brother
   D. friend

5. What does "der Löffel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bathroom
   B. spoon
   C. house
   D. window

6. What does "das Fleisch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. orange
   B. tomato
   C. meat
   D. carrot

7. What does "die Zwiebel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fish
   B. onion
   C. watermelon
   D. egg

8. Which verb do you use with "Wasser"? (1 mark)
   A. trinken
   B. schlafen
   C. kochen
   D. essen

9. Which room do you link with "Ich koche"? (1 mark)
   A. die Küche
   B. der Garten
   C. das Schlafzimmer
   D. das Badezimmer

10. What does "singen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to drink
   B. to hear
   C. to sing
   D. to read

11. Which little word goes with the noun "Schwester"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. den
   C. das
   D. der

12. What does "der Opa" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. father
   B. grandfather
   C. family
   D. sister

13. Which sentence is a question? (1 mark)
   A. Das ist mein Vater.
   B. Er ist groß.
   C. Wer ist das?
   D. Sie ist nett.

14. What does "dort" mean? (1 mark)
   A. always
   B. there
   C. here
   D. now

15. Which mark comes before a list or a quotation? (1 mark)
   A. der Doppelpunkt (:)
   B. das Komma (,)
   C. das Fragezeichen (?)
   D. der Punkt (.)

16. What does "Mai" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. December
   B. October
   C. May
   D. August

17. What does "November" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. March
   B. September
   C. November
   D. December

18. What does "Wie viele Kerzen?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. How many candles?
   B. Who is coming?
   C. When is the party?
   D. Which cake?

19. Which food is usually called healthy? (1 mark)
   A. Zucker
   B. Obst
   C. Chips
   D. Limonade

20. Which little word goes with the noun "Fisch"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. der
   C. den
   D. die

21. What is the plural of "die Bohne"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bohner
   B. die Bohnes
   C. die Bohnen
   D. die Bohne

22. Which little word goes with the noun "Bein"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. das
   C. die
   D. den

23. What does "das Auge" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. toe
   B. tooth
   C. mouth
   D. eye

24. What does "der Bauch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tooth
   B. tummy
   C. foot
   D. neck

25. What does "Regenzeit" mean? (1 mark)
   A. rainy season
   B. rainbow
   C. thunder
   D. dry season

26. What does "hören" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to read
   B. to speak
   C. to play
   D. to hear

27. What does "hinter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. next to
   B. in front of
   C. behind
   D. under

28. Which German word means "between"? (position word) (1 mark)
   A. hinter
   B. neben
   C. zwischen
   D. auf

29. Which little word goes with the noun "Tante"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. den
   C. der
   D. das

30. Which German word or phrase means "living room"? (1 mark)
   A. die Uhr
   B. der Stuhl
   C. das Wohnzimmer
   D. der Topf

31. Which German word or phrase means "window"? (1 mark)
   A. das Haus
   B. die Uhr
   C. der Herd
   D. das Fenster

32. Which German word or phrase means "shower"? (1 mark)
   A. die Dusche
   B. der Tisch
   C. der Kühlschrank
   D. die Wand

33. What is the plural of "das Geschenk"? (1 mark)
   A. die Geschenker
   B. die Geschenken
   C. die Geschenke
   D. die Geschenks

34. Which ordinal means "tenth"? (1 mark)
   A. der neunte
   B. der zehnte
   C. der elfte
   D. der achte

35. Which German word or phrase means "breakfast"? (1 mark)
   A. der Mais
   B. der Kohl
   C. die Banane
   D. das Frühstück

36. Which food group does "die Karotte" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Fleisch
   B. das Obst
   C. die Getränke
   D. das Gemüse

37. Which German word or phrase means "hair"? (1 mark)
   A. der Finger
   B. der Kopf
   C. das Haar
   D. das Auge

38. Which little word goes with the noun "Wetter"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. die
   D. der

39. Which German word means "warm"? (weather) (1 mark)
   A. neblig
   B. wolkig
   C. nass
   D. warm

40. Which little word goes with the noun "Nebel"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. die
   C. das
   D. den

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write the German words with der, die or das for: family, cabbage or kale, toilet, fog, bed. (5 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: clock, leg, house, spoon. (4 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: song, juice, egg. (3 marks)

44. Write the German for: sun, rain, wind, sky. Use der, die or das. (4 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: hand, bread, maize. (3 marks)

46. Write the German words with der, die or das for: spoon, supper. (2 marks)

47. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bathroom, potato, milk. (3 marks)

48. Say what the tongue twister "Montags macht mir meine muntere Mutter mittags meistens Mus" means in English. (2 marks)

49. Write these numbers in German: 2, 6, 10. (3 marks)

50. Give three German words or phrases for saying goodbye and say which is friendly and which is polite. (3 marks)

51. Write in German: "Today is Wednesday. Tomorrow is Thursday." (2 marks)

52. Write three steps you follow to understand a German text. (3 marks)

53. Write the forms of "sein" for ich, du and er. (3 marks)

54. Write these numbers in German: 14, 16, 18. (3 marks)

55. Write the German words with der, die or das for: watermelon, pot. (2 marks)

56. Write the German words with der, die or das for: table, fridge, kitchen. (3 marks)

57. Say why we practise tongue twisters when learning to pronounce German. (2 marks)

58. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bread, egg, tomato, water. (4 marks)

59. Write the singular and plural of Fuß in German. (2 marks)

60. Write the German words with der, die or das for: orange, lunch, carrot, grandfather. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — It is so-so
   Es geht means it is okay, so-so.

2. D — please
   Bitte means please.

3. C — Mutter
   Mutter is a die word, so we say meine Mutter.

4. B — son
   der Sohn means son.

5. B — spoon
   der Löffel means spoon.

6. C — meat
   das Fleisch means meat.

7. B — onion
   die Zwiebel means onion.

8. A — trinken
   We drink water.

9. A — die Küche
   We cook in the kitchen.

10. C — to sing
   singen means to sing.

11. A — die
   It is die Schwester, so the little word is die.

12. B — grandfather
   der Opa means grandfather.

13. C — Wer ist das?
   Only Wer ist das? asks something.

14. B — there
   dort means there.

15. A — der Doppelpunkt (:)
   The colon announces a list or speech.

16. C — May
   Mai means May.

17. C — November
   November means November.

18. A — How many candles?
   wie viele means how many.

19. B — Obst
   Fruit (Obst) is a healthy food.

20. B — der
   It is der Fisch, so the little word is der.

21. C — die Bohnen
   The plural of die Bohne is die Bohnen.

22. B — das
   It is das Bein, so the little word is das.

23. D — eye
   das Auge means eye.

24. B — tummy
   der Bauch means tummy.

25. A — rainy season
   Regen = rain and Zeit = time.

26. D — to hear
   hören means to hear.

27. C — behind
   hinter means behind.

28. C — zwischen
   between in German is zwischen.

29. A — die
   It is die Tante, so the little word is die.

30. C — das Wohnzimmer
   living room in German is das Wohnzimmer.

31. D — das Fenster
   window in German is das Fenster.

32. A — die Dusche
   shower in German is die Dusche.

33. C — die Geschenke
   The plural of das Geschenk is die Geschenke.

34. B — der zehnte
   zehn is ten, zehnte is tenth.

35. D — das Frühstück
   breakfast in German is das Frühstück.

36. D — das Gemüse
   die Karotte belongs to das Gemüse.

37. C — das Haar
   hair in German is das Haar.

38. A — das
   It is das Wetter, so the little word is das.

39. D — warm
   warm in German is warm.

40. A — der
   It is der Nebel, so the little word is der.

SECTION B
----
41. (5 marks)
   Answer: die Familie, der Kohl, die Toilette, der Nebel, das Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Uhr, das Bein, das Haus, der Löffel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Lied, der Saft, das Ei.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Sonne, der Regen, der Wind, der Himmel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Hand, das Brot, der Mais.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Löffel, das Abendessen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Badezimmer, die Kartoffel, die Milch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: On Mondays my lively mother usually makes me mush at midday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Mondays and mother, 1 mark for the mush at midday.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: zwei, sechs, zehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tschüss (friendly), Auf Wiedersehen (polite), Bis morgen (see you tomorrow).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct phrase; award the marks only if the friendly and polite ones are identified sensibly.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: Heute ist Mittwoch. Morgen ist Donnerstag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at the title and pictures; read once for the gist; read again for details and answers.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: ich bin, du bist, er ist.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct form.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: vierzehn, sechzehn, achtzehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Wassermelone, der Topf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Tisch, der Kühlschrank, die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: They repeat similar sounds, so the tongue and lips learn to move clearly and smoothly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for repeated sounds and 1 mark for clear speech.

58. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Brot, das Ei, die Tomate, das Wasser.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

59. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Fuß, die Füße.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each form.

60. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Orange, das Mittagessen, die Karotte, der Opa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).
